description: We are a team led by Fayzeh, a Computer Engineering student at Birzeit University, exploring lunar mission planning. Our goal is to build an interactive tool using NASA data to compare south-pole landing sites, sunlight, and Earth visibility. We bring experience in programming, networking, and project coordination. Join us to turn space data into clear decisions! We welcome skills in web development, GIS, data analysis, UI/UX, and space science.
